numerical_characteristics.tolerance: 1e-7 absolute tolerance, the same as the neighbouring simulation smoother comparisons
category_specific_evidence: The simulation smoother comparisons were passing variates to simulation_smoother() rather than to its simulate() method, so they compared arrays of zeros.
The PR adds a parametrized check that y_t = Z_t alpha-hat_t + eps-hat_t holds, which pins the output down without a reference implementation and covers the diffuse path.

In _univariate.pyx.in, when model._diagonal_obs_cov == 0 and model._k_endog > 1, the smoothed measurement disturbance is back-transformed by the triangular factor (trmv with transform_cholesky) to undo diagonalization: eps-hat_t = C_t eps-hat_t*.
The diffuse variant adds blas_int m_k_endog = model._k_endog to support the same handling.
test_multivariate_switch_univariate now compares the mean at switched periods rather than zeroing them out.
Skips went from 15 to 4 in the univariate tests; 11 skips were removed, including one hidden behind a self.self typo at line 643.
Full suite count went from 19706 passed / 361 skipped to 19726 passed / 350 skipped, with the same 5 pre-existing failures.
Reviewer re-ran test_univariate.py and test_multivariate_switch_univariate.py at head e9bab398a20181b6795acbf3db231e21db8c2267: 428 passed, 4 skipped.
reproduction_risks: Variates passed to the wrong method silently yield zero arrays, so comparisons pass trivially.
The triangular back-transform only applies when diagonal observation covariance is off and k_endog > 1; single-endog or diagonal cases do not exercise it.
The 5 pre-existing failures (test_plot_month, three test_forecast_index_types, TestGenericRLM::test_zero_collinear) are unrelated to this fix and may confuse results
